mandatory_elements: ink / graphic-novel illustration style with consistent line weight
halftone or limited duotone shading (not photoreal skin)
vertical 9:16 framing with centrally composed subject
no embedded captions, logos, or garbled typography in the pixels
hands/faces within acceptable illustration deformity threshold
lofi_economic.lighting_style: flat-to-soft illustrated lighting, graphic novel mood, muted charcoal and teal duotone atmosphere — never studio softbox beauty
lofi_economic.target_audience_rules: Emotional LOFI reels for relationship/parenting education. Reject photorealism drift from Flux Schnell. Reject embedded text artifacts. Accept stylized illustration anatomy.

visual_concepts.relationship: quiet domestic or symbolic figures, trust/attachment beats
visual_concepts.parenting: warm caregiving moments, soft ordinary chaos, no exploitation

mandatory_elements: Atmospheric cinematic still of ancient ruins, artefacts, or structures
Clean high-atmosphere FLUX renders are acceptable (film grain not required)
Fantasy or surreal ancient-mystery interpretations are valid when the prompt allows them
ancient_knowledge.lighting_style: Cinematic photographic lighting — the per-act LIGHTING directive picks colour temperature and direction from a 7-entry pool (warm amber / cold moonlit sidelight / harsh sun / diffuse overcast / firelight from below / silhouette against bright / single hard rim). Never flat, never muddy, never studio-softbox.
ancient_knowledge.target_audience_rules: Investigative documentary stills for Ancient Knowledge. Accept clean FLUX atmosphere and fantasy ruins. Reject only severe anatomy, floating artifacts, or corrupt renders. Do not require a named real-world monument unless the prompt asked for one.

visual_concepts.megalith: impossible-scale stone blocks, precision joints, torchlit quarry
visual_concepts.pyramid: Great Pyramid / Sphinx enclosure, hidden chambers, anomalous tooling
visual_concepts.pre_flood: Göbekli Tepe, Younger Dryas, buried temple, starfield horizon

visual_concepts.lost_city: Yonaguni, Dwarka, El Dorado — submerged or jungle-swallowed ruins

script_rules.voice: Investigative documentary narration for Ancient Knowledge. Delivered by a calm, curious researcher voice, present tense, second-person only when directly addressing the viewer. Grounded in the material record — cite the site, the artefact, the measurement, the date. Never fantasy, never ancient-aliens cosplay. State what is verified, then state what remains unexplained and let the viewer feel the gap.
script_rules.word_budget: Derive from the requested reel duration via ``config.words_for_duration(target_duration_s)`` — NEVER a fixed word count. Default target_duration_s is 80-90 s when no override is passed; a longer or shorter duration passed via the CLI ``--video-length`` parameter scales the word budget by the same 2.25 wps rate. Exact duration match is not required — aim to land at or near the requested target (a 5-minute request produces ~5 minutes of narration, not default-length narration padded or cut to fit).
script_rules.structural_pacing: Structure scales with act count, which itself scales with target duration via the two-tier planner (``core.reel_sequence_engine.compute_two_tier_act_count``): Tier 1 = first ~90 s @ ~4.5 s / still, capped at 20 acts (fast-cut opening rhythm); Tier 2 = remaining narration @ ~10 s / still (8-12 s clamp band, slower body). Same shape regardless of length — Act 1 = anchor hook (identify the real site), Act 2-3 = introduce the anomaly, middle acts = expand each layer of the mystery, final 2 acts = pose the unanswered question then CTA. Longer durations produce more acts of the same shape, NOT the same act count stretched with longer per-act holds.
script_rules.hook_rule: First 3 acts (~9 s) are the anchor hook: name the specific site or artefact, drop the anomaly in one line, and set the question. Never open with a rhetorical filler or a generic 'ancient civilizations...' preamble. The hook must survive as a standalone Shorts opener even if the viewer bounces at act 4.
script_rules.cta: CTA is a dedicated final act, generated as a separate audio block with a mandatory 1.0 s silence gap before it (see video-pipeline rule 2). Fixed text for ancient_knowledge: 'Follow Ancient Knowledge for more hidden mysteries.' NEVER embed the CTA phrase inside the narration script itself — the compile step stitches it after the narration so the final still can never be visually clipped.
forbidden_phrases: ancient civilizations were more advanced than we thought

motion_rules.motion_cadence: Every act cycles through 4 motion profiles indexed by ``act_index % 4``: (0) Rapid Push-In 1.00→1.42 zoom, 1.65× pan; (1) Wide Pull-Out Reveal 1.48→1.02, 1.00× pan reversed; (2) Sweeping Lateral Parallax 1.10→1.32, 4.60× pan; (3) Overhead Crane Sweep 1.18→1.40, 2.30× pan reversed. Base pan amplitudes: X=60 px, Y=42 px. No static slow-zooms — every still moves.
motion_rules.parallax_depth_directive: Every image prompt MUST specify one foreground element (dust particles, stone arch fragment, human observer silhouette) AND one background element (temple silhouette, starfield, distant horizon line) so camera motion produces visible parallax separation between the two planes.
motion_rules.shot_variety_rule: No two consecutive acts repeat the same shot type OR lighting setup OR subject category. The per-act shot pool (wide establishing, extreme close-up, low-angle, high-angle, three-quarter side, over-the-shoulder / through-foreground, medium off-center) is drawn round-robin with a no-adjacent-repeat guard. Same rule applies across BOTH tiers of the two-tier pacing model — long-video Tier 2 acts still need the same variety, just held longer.
motion_rules.post_fx_toggles: ancient_knowledge defaults: ENABLE_FLICKER=True (torch brightness oscillation), ENABLE_LIGHT_RAYS=True (volumetric warm-gold beam), ENABLE_DUST_PARTICLES=True (55-particle upward drift), ENABLE_LIGHT_REFRACTION=False (only enabled per crystal-subject topic). Sub-bass transition boom (65 Hz, 400 ms, 0.15 amplitude) at every scene cut.

music_rules.mood: Dark, slow, cinematic mystery — under-the-surface tension that supports investigative narration without competing with it. Never triumphant, never celebratory, never lofi chillhop. Think 'documentary about a missing artefact', not 'trailer for a blockbuster'.
music_rules.sound_palette: Sub-bass drone (30-80 Hz), sparse mid-range percussion (no drum kits, no hi-hats), occasional string swells at act transitions, warm analog tape hiss floor. Ancient instrument colour welcome (bone flute, sub-Saharan kora, distant temple bell) as long as it stays background.
music_rules.mix_levels: Background music volume = 0.70 (~-3 dB relative to voiceover); narration playback rate = 1.05× (``_NARRATION_SPEED`` in agents.media/audio_engine.py). Sub-bass transition boom (65 Hz, 400 ms, 0.15 amplitude) at every scene cut, synthesised with NumPy — not a sampled kick drum.
music_rules.generation: Ambient track sourced from ElevenLabs SFX API (``/v1/sound-generation``), 20 s loop, ``prompt_influence=0.7``. Prompt seeds derived from the episode's topic keyword (megalith / oopart / lost_city / pre_flood) so the music aligns with the visual concept.

mandatory_elements: 8–10 FRAME LORE (90–120s): F1 Master Mei base anchor + meditation (≤8s); F3 agonizing human slaves / cybernetic implants (RAG override); F7 extreme close-up human cyborg (9–10 frame lore); penultimate matrix pod facility breakout (RAG override); final Master Mei base anchor + temple eyes-on-camera

Master Mei DNA: snow-white topknot + two long white chest locks, extra-long ultra-thick snow-white eyebrows past temples, mid-chest snow-white beard + flowing mustache, white inner robe + black vest gold lapels + mala beads
Mei environments: ~70% high-altitude nature (cliffs/ridges/sea of clouds), ~30% open-air mountain shrines; templates are references — match script philosophy
FLUX dystopia: 120–180 words, mandatory prefix 'Cyberpunk dystopian Earth, attention monopoly era:', no tag spam
Environment: neon billboards, hanging cable bundles, industrial haze, cybernetic conduits
role-separated: never fuse cybernetics onto Master Mei
NO firearms / handguns / rifles / modern action-movie tropes
master_mei.lighting_style: moody cinematic lighting, dark atmospheric — cold moonlight / storm lightning / dawn rim light / warm torchfire, dystopian red neon reflections against deep dramatic shadows
master_mei.target_audience_rules: Western/US men seeking self-mastery. STRICT 8–10 frame lore for 90–120s. Scene 1 ≤8s meditation landscapes. Scenes 2+ ≈10–12s. Frame 1 + final MUST show Master Mei. NEVER firearms, Gossip Goblin, gore, gym, teens.
